label.aiNote: Produced by software. It is not a clinical opinion.
label.notReviewed: No practitioner has reviewed this yet
label.notReviewedNote: Only the automatic result is available so far.

queue.title: Cases to review
queue.subtitle: Cases waiting for your decision
queue.emptyHint: Assessments needing your review will appear here.
queue.orderNote: Ordered by what the app flagged and how long each case has waited. This is a workload order, not a clinical priority.
queue.notPermittedHint: This queue is not available in your role.
queue.loadFailed: Could not load the case list
queue.loadFailedBody: The information could not be read from this device. Nothing has been lost. This is not the same as there being nothing here.

case.title: Case review
case.notFoundHint: It may belong to another practitioner, or the link may be out of date.
case.notAskedNote: Questions not listed were not asked, which is not the same as answered no.
case.modelNote: The app's classifier is a research prototype and is roughly 71% accurate. Treat every automatic result as a prompt to listen, not as a finding.

location.audioMissing: The audio for this location is missing
location.audioMissingHint: This does not mean the recording was silent or normal. Nothing can be judged from it.
location.noPrevious: No earlier recording at this location
location.changed: A change in respiratory sound pattern was detected between these recordings.
location.unchanged: No change in respiratory sound pattern was detected between these recordings.

form.title: Your conclusion
form.intro: Record what you conclude about this assessment. Your conclusion is stored separately from the automatic result, which is never changed.
form.notesHint: What you write here is shown to the patient alongside your conclusion.
form.locationLabel: Which location does this apply to?
form.locationHint: The health worker sees this, so name the site you mean.
form.submittedHint: The patient will now see your conclusion alongside the automatic result.
form.immutabilityNote: Submitting does not change the automatic result. It is kept exactly as the app produced it.

outcome.CONFIRMED: I agree with the automatic result
outcome.CONFIRMED_DESC: The app's result matches what you hear.
outcome.DISAGREED: I disagree with the automatic result
outcome.DISAGREED_DESC: You reach a different conclusion. Say why.
outcome.MODIFIED_DESC: Record the pattern you hear instead, for a location.
outcome.UNCERTAIN_DESC: Not enough to conclude either way. Say what is missing.
outcome.REPEAT_REQUESTED_DESC: Ask the health worker to repeat a recording, and say why.

report.title: Assessment summary
report.disclaimer: Ausculta is a research prototype. It is a screening aid, not a diagnostic device, and it is not registered for clinical use. Every automatic result on this page was produced by software and reviewed by the named practitioner.
report.notReviewedYet: Not yet reviewed by a practitioner
report.noConclusion: No practitioner conclusion has been recorded for this assessment.
report.nothingDecided: The app did not produce a result for this location.
report.printHint: Use your browser's print option to produce a paper copy.
report.loadFailed: This summary could not be read. Nothing about the assessment has changed.

error.REVIEW_NOT_FOUND: That case is not available to you.
error.REVIEW_NOT_PERMITTED: You do not have permission to review.
error.REVIEW_LOCATION_REQUIRED: Choose which location this applies to.
error.REVIEW_UNKNOWN_RECORDING: That recording is not part of this assessment.
error.SUBMIT_FAILED: Your conclusion could not be saved. Nothing was lost — try again.
